fullTextZH: 你好，今天我要说一个故事，叫：《父子抬驴》。
fullTextEN: Hello, today I want to tell a story called: 'Father and Son Carrying a Donkey'.

fullTextZH: 以前有一个爸爸和一个孩子，还有一头驴。
fullTextEN: Once upon a time, there was a father and a child, and also a donkey.
They were walking.
They walked and walked,
Someone said: 'Oh,
Look, are they fools?
Why have a donkey but not ride it?'
The father heard this,
He said: 'Son,
Someone said we are fools,

fullTextZH: 因为我们有驴，可是我们不骑。”
fullTextEN: because we have a donkey but we don't ride it.'
'Son, you get on, you ride.'
So now the son rides the donkey,
and the father walks.
They walked and walked,
Then someone else said,

fullTextZH: “哎呀！你看那个儿子真的不孝顺！
fullTextEN: 'Oh dear! Look at that son, really unfilial!
Look, his father is exhausted.
Why is he riding the donkey,
while his father walks?'
Oh no! Really not filial!

fullTextZH: 这个爸爸听到了，他说：“儿子，
fullTextEN: This father heard it and said, 'Son,'
Someone said you are not filial,

fullTextZH: 因为你骑驴，可是我走路。
fullTextEN: because you are riding the donkey, but I am walking.
You get down, I will ride.'

fullTextZH: 所以，现在爸爸骑驴，儿子走路。
fullTextEN: So now the father is riding the donkey, and the son is walking.
They walked and walked,
and someone said again,

fullTextZH: “哎呀！你看那个爸爸真的不是好爸爸！
fullTextEN: 'Oh no! Look at that father, really not a good father!

fullTextZH: 他骑驴，可是他的儿子走路。
fullTextEN: He is riding the donkey, but his son is walking.
His son is so small,

fullTextZH: 你看，他的儿子要累死了。”
fullTextEN: look, his son is about to be exhausted.'

fullTextZH: 这个爸爸听到了，他说：“儿子，
fullTextEN: This father heard it and said, 'Son,'
They say I am not a good father,

fullTextZH: 因为我骑驴，可是你走路。
fullTextEN: because I am riding the donkey, but you are walking.

fullTextZH: 你也上来，我们一起骑驴。”
fullTextEN: You come up too, we will ride the donkey together.'

fullTextZH: 所以，现在爸爸和儿子一起骑驴。
fullTextEN: So now the father and son are riding the donkey together.

fullTextZH: 他们走啊走啊，又有人说：
fullTextEN: They walked and walked, and someone said again:

fullTextZH: “哎呀！好可怜的驴！那么小、那么瘦的驴！
fullTextEN: 'Oh no! Poor donkey! Such a small, thin donkey!

fullTextZH: 有两个人一起骑这头驴，
fullTextEN: Two people are riding this donkey together,
Look, the donkey is about to be exhausted.

fullTextZH: 这个爸爸听到了，他说：“儿子，
fullTextEN: The father heard this and said, 'Son,'

fullTextZH: 有人说我们欺负我们的驴。
fullTextEN: Someone said we are bullying our donkey.
Let's not ride it, get down, get down.

fullTextZH: “我们的驴很累，所以我们一起抬驴吧。”
fullTextEN: Our donkey is very tired, so let's carry it together.

fullTextZH: 所以，现在他们一起抬驴。
fullTextEN: So now they are carrying the donkey together.
The story ends.
